mode_certificate.state_transition: The same sole artifact changes from candidate-active state to pre-transformation-restored state; no second artifact or alternate lineage is created.
mode_certificate.trigger: The terminal call witnesses a specific incompatibility between a candidate-caused transformation in the carried closure and an obligation visible in task, anchor_contract, or task_constraints.
